text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what actually happened.

What worked:
→ Reps reclaimed about 5 hours a week from CRM updates.
→ Follow-up emails went out same day, not three days later.
→ Managers finally heard real customer objections, not summaries.

What didn't:
→ Spotty cell coverage in rural territories broke recordings.
→ Some buyers hesitated until we asked consent upfront.

The biggest lesson: adoption followed trust, not training. Reps used it when they saw managers coaching with it, not auditing with it.

Would we keep it? Yes, with clear consent scripts and offline capture.

Next quarter, we're expanding to three regional teams, starting with onboarding.

What did your team learn from your first AI pilot?
